scripts.codegen: cd ../../apps/api && bun scripts/export-mcp-tool-registry.ts && cd ../../packages/cli && bun run src/codegen.ts && bun run src/codegen-version.ts && oxfmt .
scripts.build: bun run codegen:runtime && rm -rf dist && bun ../../packages/scripts/src/tsc-native.ts -p tsconfig.build.json && cp src/generated/registry-snapshot.json dist/generated/registry-snapshot.json && printf '%s\n' '#!/usr/bin/env node' > dist/cli.js.tmp && tail -n +2 dist/cli.js >> dist/cli.js.tmp && mv dist/cli.js.tmp dist/cli.js && chmod +x dist/cli.js
scripts.lint: bun run codegen:runtime && cd ../.. && bun --bun oxlint -c oxlint.config.ts --report-unused-disable-directives-severity=error --type-aware --type-check packages/cli
scripts.lint:fix: bun run codegen:runtime && cd ../.. && bun --bun oxlint -c oxlint.config.ts --type-aware --fix packages/cli
